nl: Rename the C# class OrderService to OrderManager, update its use in Program.cs and rename the file OrderService.cs to OrderManager.cs. Keep the CRLF line endings.

entries.content_utf8:
Microsoft Visual Studio Solution File, Format Version 12.00
Project("{FAE04EC0}") = "Orders", "src\Orders\Orders.csproj"

namespace Orders;

public sealed record Order(int Id, string Customer, decimal Amount);

reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'src/Orders/OrderService.cs'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'public sealed class OrderService'; $n = 'public sealed class OrderManager'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in src/Orders/OrderService.cs' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'src/Orders/Program.cs'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
$o = 'new OrderService()'; $n = 'new OrderManager()'
if (([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($o))).Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected match count in src/Orders/Program.cs' }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t.Replace($o, $n))
Move-Item -LiteralPath 'src/Orders/OrderService.cs' -Destination 'src/Orders/OrderManager.cs'
